transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

I'm here because of work. I work at a meat processing plant, and... I just can't seem to finish things. I'll start the sanitation steps, or the batch logs, or the end-of-line paperwork, and then... I just somehow leave out the last parts. Even though I know I have to finish them. My job depends on it, but I still don't do it.
What tends to happen right before you leave those last parts unfinished?
I don't really know. I just... stop, I guess. I'm not really paying attention to what happens right before. It just happens.
Did you have similar trouble finishing schoolwork or chores when you were a child?

Yeah, I guess so. My mom actually still has some of my old report cards from around fourth grade. They usually said I was bright, but... that I needed constant reminders to finish my classwork or actually turn in my homework. I understood the lessons fine, but I'd just miss chunks of instructions unless the teacher was right there next to me.
Do you often feel physically restless, fidgety, or like you have a hard time sitting still?
No, not really. I don't... I don't think I have trouble sitting still. I just sit there.
